  "title": "Country Human Resource Manager",
  "description": "JSK Consulting Group - Our client is recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Country&nbsp;Human Resource Manager

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	We are seeking an experienced Country HR Manager to provide strategic and operational HR support across the assigned country.
	The successful candidate will serve as a strategic HR Business Partner, aligning people strategies with business objectives while overseeing the end-to-end employee lifecycle, talent acquisition, employee engagement, performance management, learning and development, employee relations, HR compliance, and HR operations.


Key Responsibilities
Employee Lifecycle Management &amp; HR Operations:


	Manage the end-to-end employee lifecycle from recruitment and onboarding through employee engagement, development, retention, and exit.
	Lead recruitment activities for assigned positions, from sourcing and selection through offer management and onboarding.
	Drive employee engagement initiatives aimed at improving employee experience and reducing attrition.
	Support employee query resolution and grievance management.
	Ensure effective onboarding and induction of new employees.
	Monitor HR processes and ensure timely and accurate HR documentation and records.
	Manage HR budgets and identify opportunities for cost optimisation.
	Ensure accurate and up-to-date HR data and HRMS records.


Talent Management, Performance &amp; Learning:


	Drive the performance management cycle, including goal setting, KRA communication, mid-year and annual appraisals.
	Ensure timely completion of probation and performance review processes.
	Support managers in developing and implementing Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs).
	Participate in talent management and succession initiatives.
	Identify training needs and coordinate learning and development activities.
	Communicate available learning programmes and initiatives to employees.
	Monitor compliance with approved training and development plans.


HR Business Partnering &amp; Employee Communication:


	Partner with country leadership and business teams to understand workforce requirements and provide effective HR solutions.
	Interpret and implement HR policies and procedures consistently across the organisation.
	Promote workplace ethics, discipline, company values, and appropriate employee conduct.
	Develop and coordinate employee communication initiatives in collaboration with leadership and Corporate HR.
	Support employee surveys, feedback exercises, and other HR projects.
	Develop and implement country-specific employee recognition and engagement initiatives.
	Support the deployment and review of broader organisational rewards and recognition programmes.


Statutory Compliance &amp; Employee Relations:


	Ensure compliance with applicable employment laws, labour regulations, and statutory requirements.
	Maintain accurate HR records and documentation required for statutory compliance.
	Manage outsourced employees/associates, including recruitment, attendance, payroll coordination, and compliance.
	Maintain effective employee relations and address workplace concerns appropriately.
	Liaise with relevant government authorities and labour representatives where required.
	Manage relationships with workforce unions where applicable to support smooth business operations.


Key Success Areas


	Employee engagement and retention
	Talent acquisition and workforce planning
	Employee relations and grievance resolution
	Performance management
	HR policy implementation
	Statutory and HR compliance
	Outsourced workforce management
	HR data accuracy and process compliance
	Learning and development
	Stakeholder and employee communication.


Key Requirements


	8&ndash;10 years of relevant HR experience, preferably in Business HR, Regional HR, or a similar HR leadership role.
	Strong experience across HR operations and the employee lifecycle.
	Solid knowledge of HR policies, practices, labour laws, and statutory compliance.
	Proven experience in employee relations and grievance management.
	Experience in talent acquisition, performance management, employee engagement, and learning &amp; development.
	Experience managing outsourced employees and HR operations will be an advantage.
	Experience working in a multi-location or geographically distributed workforce is desirable.


Educational Qualifications:


	Bachelor&#39;s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Industrial Relations, or a related field.
	MBA or equivalent qualification in Human Resources is preferred.


Key Skills &amp; Competencies:


	Strategic HR Business Partnering
	Stakeholder Management
	People Management
	Employee Relations
	Talent Acquisition
	Performance Management
	Effective Coordination
	Strong Communication Skills
	Interviewing &amp; Selection
	Problem Solving
	Customer Orientation
	HR Policy &amp; Compliance
	Employee Engagement.


Preferred Industry Background:


	Candidates with experience in Telecommunications, FMCG, FMCD, Pharmaceutical, or other large-scale organisations will be considered.
	Experience in Plant HR with a transition or strong exposure to Business HR is also relevant.


Working Environment:


	The role requires the ability to work effectively with a geographically distributed workforce, country leadership, employees, Corporate HR, recruitment partners, and relevant external authorities.


Salary
$20,000 - $40,000 annually.",

Country Human Resource Manager Job at JSK Consulting Group




        
    

        
        JSK Consulting Group - Our client is recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Country Human Resource Manager

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	We are seeking an experienced Country HR Manager to provide strategic and operational HR support across the assigned country.
	The successful candidate will serve as a strategic HR Business Partner, aligning people strategies with business objectives while overseeing the end-to-end employee lifecycle, talent acquisition, employee engagement, performance management, learning and development, employee relations, HR compliance, and HR operations.


Key Responsibilities
Employee Lifecycle Management & HR Operations:


	Manage the end-to-end employee lifecycle from recruitment and onboarding through employee engagement, development, retention, and exit.
	Lead recruitment activities for assigned positions, from sourcing and selection through offer management and onboarding.
	Drive employee engagement initiatives aimed at improving employee experience and reducing attrition.
	Support employee query resolution and grievance management.
	Ensure effective onboarding and induction of new employees.
	Monitor HR processes and ensure timely and accurate HR documentation and records.
	Manage HR budgets and identify opportunities for cost optimisation.
	Ensure accurate and up-to-date HR data and HRMS records.


Talent Management, Performance & Learning:


	Drive the performance management cycle, including goal setting, KRA communication, mid-year and annual appraisals.
	Ensure timely completion of probation and performance review processes.
	Support managers in developing and implementing Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs).
	Participate in talent management and succession initiatives.
	Identify training needs and coordinate learning and development activities.
	Communicate available learning programmes and initiatives to employees.
	Monitor compliance with approved training and development plans.


HR Business Partnering & Employee Communication:


	Partner with country leadership and business teams to understand workforce requirements and provide effective HR solutions.
	Interpret and implement HR policies and procedures consistently across the organisation.
	Promote workplace ethics, discipline, company values, and appropriate employee conduct.
	Develop and coordinate employee communication initiatives in collaboration with leadership and Corporate HR.
	Support employee surveys, feedback exercises, and other HR projects.
	Develop and implement country-specific employee recognition and engagement initiatives.
	Support the deployment and review of broader organisational rewards and recognition programmes.


Statutory Compliance & Employee Relations:


	Ensure compliance with applicable employment laws, labour regulations, and statutory requirements.
	Maintain accurate HR records and documentation required for statutory compliance.
	Manage outsourced employees/associates, including recruitment, attendance, payroll coordination, and compliance.
	Maintain effective employee relations and address workplace concerns appropriately.
	Liaise with relevant government authorities and labour representatives where required.
	Manage relationships with workforce unions where applicable to support smooth business operations.


Key Success Areas


	Employee engagement and retention
	Talent acquisition and workforce planning
	Employee relations and grievance resolution
	Performance management
	HR policy implementation
	Statutory and HR compliance
	Outsourced workforce management
	HR data accuracy and process compliance
	Learning and development
	Stakeholder and employee communication.


Key Requirements


	8–10 years of relevant HR experience, preferably in Business HR, Regional HR, or a similar HR leadership role.
	Strong experience across HR operations and the employee lifecycle.
	Solid knowledge of HR policies, practices, labour laws, and statutory compliance.
	Proven experience in employee relations and grievance management.
	Experience in talent acquisition, performance management, employee engagement, and learning & development.
	Experience managing outsourced employees and HR operations will be an advantage.
	Experience working in a multi-location or geographically distributed workforce is desirable.


Educational Qualifications:


	Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Industrial Relations, or a related field.
	MBA or equivalent qualification in Human Resources is preferred.


Key Skills & Competencies:


	Strategic HR Business Partnering
	Stakeholder Management
	People Management
	Employee Relations
	Talent Acquisition
	Performance Management
	Effective Coordination
	Strong Communication Skills
	Interviewing & Selection
	Problem Solving
	Customer Orientation
	HR Policy & Compliance
	Employee Engagement.


Preferred Industry Background:


	Candidates with experience in Telecommunications, FMCG, FMCD, Pharmaceutical, or other large-scale organisations will be considered.
	Experience in Plant HR with a transition or strong exposure to Business HR is also relevant.


Working Environment:


	The role requires the ability to work effectively with a geographically distributed workforce, country leadership, employees, Corporate HR, recruitment partners, and relevant external authorities.


Salary
$20,000 - $40,000 annually.

With food at the core of the business, Glovo delivers any product within your city at any time of day. Our vision and ambition are not only to make everything immediately available in your city but it is also to offer our employees the job of their lives. A job where you'll be challenged and have the most fun working in through tech-enabled experiences.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Account Manager SMB 

Job Location: Lagos

The Journey

	Run a high-tempo engagement rhythm: around 40 focused partner calls a day and 1–2 field days a week meeting partners face to face.
	Lead with data: run weekly portfolio reviews in Looker, Google Sheets and Salesforce, spot trends early, and bring partners clear, data-backed business reviews.
	Fix what costs partners orders: partner with Partner Operations, Live Ops and Courier Ops to improve availability, prep times, cancellations and delivery times.
	Be the voice of the partner inside Glovo: share market insights and help shape new campaigns and products.
	Protect the portfolio: spot at-risk partners early, resolve escalations end to end and keep churn low.

	1–3 years in account management, sales, business development or merchant/vendor management, ideally in a marketplace, food delivery, fintech, e-commerce or FMCG business.

	Strong analytical skills. You're confident in Excel/Google Sheets and dashboards and use data to decide where to spend your time.
	Experience managing many accounts at once with discipline and follow-through.
	Ownership and resilience. You solve problems end to end and do your best work in a fast-moving environment.
	Excellent spoken and written English. You're based in Lagos or Abuja and happy to spend time in the field.

	Knowledge of food delivery / q-commerce metrics and the Lagos or Abuja restaurant and retail scene.
	Experience selling digital ads or promotions
	SQL or Looker skills.
	Yoruba, Hausa, Igbo or Pidgin.
	Bachelor's Degree in Business, Economics, Marketing or a related field.

At Hana-Mera Recruitment, we specialize in helping startups hire smart, not just fast. We understand the unique pressure founders face: tight timelines, limited resources, and the critical need to make every hire count. One wrong hire can slow momentum. The right one? Game-changing. With a proven track record of helping startups across Nigeria, India, the US, and beyond, we’ve successfully placed high-impact talent across product, engineering, operations, growth, and leadership. From seed stage founders making their first hire to scaling startups expanding globally, we’ve been the trusted partner behind growth. But we’re not just here for startups, we’re here for talent, too. We help job seekers become standout candidates through CV revamps, LinkedIn optimization, and personalized career strategy. Whether you’re breaking into the startup world or taking the next big step, we help you get seen and get hired. We know startups. We know talent. And we know how to bring the right people together when it matters most.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Customer Service Manager

Job Locations: Akwa Ibom and Delta
Employment Type: Full-time

The Role


	We are seeking an experienced Customer Service Manager to lead the customer service team, drive service excellence, manage customer issues and support the bank’s sales and relationship growth objectives.


Key Responsibilities


	Lead, manage and coach the Customer Service team to deliver excellent customer experience.
	Set and monitor weekly and monthly team goals and performance.
	Handle and resolve complex customer enquiries, complaints and service issues.
	Drive customer retention, satisfaction and loyalty.
	Support account opening, loan applications, referrals and cross-selling of banking products.
	Identify customer needs and recommend appropriate banking solutions.
	Monitor service quality and provide regular coaching and performance feedback to team members.
	Ensure compliance with operational, audit and security procedures.
	Monitor customer feedback and implement improvements where required.
	Promote the use of digital banking and alternative channels.
	Prepare and review reports on customer service performance and team productivity.
	Work with other teams to improve service delivery and contribute to the growth of the bank’s deposit and loan portfolio.


Requirements


	Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Management, Telecommunications or a related field.
	Minimum of 6–7 years of experience working in banking/financial services.
	Strong experience in Banking Customer Service/Customer Information Service.
	Proven team leadership and people management experience.
	Strong knowledge of banking operations, customer service, compliance and audit.
	Excellent communication, problem-solving and relationship management skills.
	Strong attention to detail and ability to work under pressure.
	Good knowledge of digital banking solutions and customer service channels.
